professional_work.summary: This document serves as a standard reusable NDIS care plan template designed for provider staff, participants, and their representatives. It includes comprehensive sections necessary for safe participant support, risk management, responsibilities, and review processes.

deliverable.audience: NDIS provider staff, participant and participant representative

sections.heading: Participant Identity
sections.content:
Participant Name: [PARTICIPANT_NAME]
Date of Birth: [DOB]
NDIS Number: [NDIS_NUMBER]
Address: [ADDRESS]
Gender: [GENDER]
Preferred Language: [PREFERRED_LANGUAGE]
Emergency Contact: [EMERGENCY_CONTACT]

sections.heading: Goals and Preferences
sections.content:
Goals: [GOALS]
Preferences: [PREFERENCES]
Communication Needs: [COMMUNICATION_NEEDS]
Cultural Considerations: [CULTURAL_CONSIDERATIONS]
Support Preferences: [SUPPORT_PREFERENCES]
